provenance: 2010 to July 2025: written from memory of the central banks' published calendars, because the build sandbox cannot reach ecb.europa.eu or boj.or.jp (not checked against them). August 2025 on: copied from council/events.mjs (RAW.ECB, RAW.BOJ), which was checked against the official pages. Where to check: ECB Governing Council monetary policy meeting calendar and the press releases of each date (ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/mgcgc/html/index.en.html, ecb.europa.eu/press/pr/html/index.en.html); Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Meeting schedule and the statements on monetary policy of each meeting (boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/index.htm, boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmdeci/state_all/index.htm).
rules: Scheduled decisions only (the last day of a scheduled meeting). Unscheduled or emergency announcements are listed apart and are never events; no placebo day falls within 3 days of them either.

unsure.2010-2014: monthly meetings, as a rule the first Thursday of the month; individual dates not checked

ECB.clock: The decision was published at 13:45 Frankfurt time for most of the sample and at 14:15 Frankfurt time later (council/events.mjs uses 14:15 from 2025); the date of the change is not known from memory (thought to be 2022). The minute is therefore set per date by the direction-free clock check of PREREGISTRATION.md.

unsure.2010-2015: fourteen meetings a year (some one-day); every date from memory and the least certain part of the list
unsure.2010-11-05: brought forward from the scheduled date; from memory
unsure.2011-03-14: held right after the earthquake, from memory; treated as the scheduled meeting
unsure.2020-03-16: the scheduled March meeting brought forward to 16 Mar; treated as scheduled

BOJ.clock: No fixed minute (usually 03:00-04:30 UTC, around noon Tokyo time); the release bar is found from the candles by the rule of PREREGISTRATION.md. A date where no bar qualifies is skipped, so a wrong date usually gives no trade.
